uso.en: What you do usually or right now.
A finished action at a specific time (ayer, el lunes).
How things were or what you used to do.
What will happen; also a guess about now.
Haber + participle: what you have done (in Latin America, mostly for experiences).
After wishes, doubts and «que» in many sentences: quiero que vengas.
